turn.question: Draft the award memo for the VP.
turn.answer: The award memo for the VP has been drafted and saved as `Award_Memo_RFX_2026_PKG_017_docx.docx`. It summarizes the vendor qualification process, the recommended award allocation, and notes the need for verifying the two unconfirmed price values from Ganesh Kraft Traders.

sections.body: This memo details the award recommendation for RFX-2026-PKG-017 for corrugated packaging. Following a rigorous evaluation of all vendor quotes and quality requirements, we recommend splitting the award between Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. and Ganesh Kraft Traders.
sections.heading: Executive Summary

sections.body: All responding vendors were evaluated against two mandatory quality requirements: in-house ECT/BCT testing and a valid ISO 9001 certificate. Only Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. and Ganesh Kraft Traders met all criteria. Other vendors were excluded: Bhiwandi Corrugated Industries LLP and Sahyadri Boxes & Sheets failed the testing requirement, and Nakoda Paper Packs had an unclear ISO 9001 status.
sections.heading: Vendor Qualification

sections.body: Based on the qualified pool, the award was allocated to the vendor offering the lowest price per line. The total value of the recommended award is 58,302,130 INR. Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. is awarded 28 lines (53,310,990 INR), and Ganesh Kraft Traders is awarded 2 lines (4,991,140 INR). All values are ex-tax and ex-freight.
sections.heading: Award Recommendation
Next Steps and Risks
sections.body: The award to Ganesh Kraft Traders involves 2 unconfirmed price values (lines L06 and L23). These items were flagged due to medium confidence in the source documents. We recommend a final verification of these prices before the contract is finalized.
